nodes.name: _summary-split.json
nodes.summary: Machine-readable aggregate results of the judge-swap validation probe, containing per-candidate verdicts, κ statistics, rankings by consistency, and recommended primary/backup judge models for the LoCoMo benchmark evaluation pipeline.

nodes.name: deepseek-mt-comparison-memo.md
nodes.summary: Short memo documenting the impact of increasing DeepSeek's max_tokens from 1024 to 2048 during judge-swap validation, finding that the truncation issue is fixable and the model's agreement rate is unaffected by the token limit change.

nodes.name: kappa-analysis.md
nodes.summary: Inter-rater agreement analysis (Cohen's κ) for a 4-candidate judge roster in the §1.3g judge-swap validation, reporting per-candidate κ scores, an aggregate MULTI_PASS verdict, and secondary tie-break criteria to select between equally performing judges.

nodes.name: kappa-split-analysis.md
nodes.summary: Extended dual-κ split analysis (§1.3h) breaking down inter-rater agreement on unanimous vs. split sub-samples, diagnosing MiniMax bias on challenging questions, and presenting two viable judge-routing paths with PM adjudication required to finalize selection.

nodes.name: reprobe-memo.md
nodes.summary: Exit memo for the §1.3h judge-swap re-probe, summarizing the INCONCLUSIVE_BUT_OPERATIONAL_SIGNAL verdict, novel MiniMax bias finding, routing recommendation, and cost/wall-clock data, and specifying the required PM next step.

nodes.name: validation-memo.md
nodes.summary: Summary memo for §1.3g judge-swap validation confirming a MULTI_PASS aggregate verdict with all 4 candidate judges achieving κ=1.0 against the Opus+GPT consensus baseline, plus a speed-and-parse-rate tiebreak ranking.
